title: PaolaBaak-Pack
description: Custom texture pack themed after streamer and content creator PaolaBaak, officially made by RussoViller_ for PaolaBaak's fans.
body:
- The PaolaBaak-Pack texture pack is a texture pack made entirely in the theme of the TikTok streamer and content creator known as "PaolaBaak".

- The texture content will be entirely based on things she likes and does during her live streams, the perfect texture for true PaolaBaak fans, but anyone can use it.
